title: MendingPriority
description: "Lets you choose which armor piece gets repaired by Mending enchantment. Press L to cycle between Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots, or Vanilla mode — actionbar shows your current target
body:
# MendingPriority

Tired of Mending randomly repairing the wrong armor piece? This mod lets you set a priority target.

## How It Works
Press **L** to cycle through repair modes. Your selected armor piece will receive Mending repair priority **first** — before any other piece gets repaired.

- **Helmet** — helmet gets priority for XP repair
- **Chestplate** — chestplate gets priority for XP repair
- **Leggings** — leggings get priority for XP repair
- **Boots** — boots get priority for XP repair
- **Vanilla** — normal random Minecraft behavior (default)

Each time you press L, a short message appears in your actionbar showing the current target, like `Repair Target: Helmet`.

## Fallback
If the selected armor piece doesn't have Mending or is already at full durability, the mod automatically falls back to vanilla behavior.

## No Bloat
No config screen. No GUI. No menus. Just one keybind. The key can be rebound in Options → Controls → MendingPriority.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
